title: Side-by-side comparison
summary: 2 to 4 videos playing side by side, each 540x960 with a label (1080x960 for two, 1620x960 for three). For comparing versions, themes or systems.

inputs.audio: which video's sound to keep, by position (default 1 = the first; 0 = silent)
inputs.height: panel height in pixels (default 960; width is 9:16 of it)

uses: ffmpeg only: renders projects/<project>/out/cut.mp4 directly (the video frame is 9:16; this is a landscape review layout)
